sources.title: Smart Recycle Bin
sources.snippet: The Smart Recycle Bin uses Artificial Intelligence and IoT technologies to automate waste sorting. The system uses a Raspberry Pi 4, camera module, ultrasonic sensors, servo motor, and stepper motor integrated with the YOLO11 object detection model.

sources.title: GitHub - Aliqatrawi/Smart-recycle-bin: AI-powered smart recycle bin for ...
sources.snippet: Project Overview SMART RECYCLE BIN: AN AI-DRIVEN IOT SYSTEM FOR AUTOMATED WASTE CLASSIFICATION is a senior project that uses Artificial Intelligence and IoT to classify waste automatically. The system detects waste objects using a camera and a YOLO AI model, then sorts them into the correct category.

sources.title: GitHub - rismeh/Smart_Recycle_Bin_AI
sources.snippet: The tasks include: SmartBin AI: Build a compact TFLite model to classify recyclable categories (plastic, aluminum, paper) and detect contamination or incorrect items. Integrate LED/screen feedback. Sustainability Mirror AI: Implement camera-based detection for presence, reusable containers, and gestures, with real-time motivational overlays.

sources.title: SMART BIN - AI Incorporated
sources.snippet: We took our versatile mobile platform and adapted it to create a robotic waste receptacle that every homeowner can use. Depth Sensors - Measure distance. Stereo Vision Cameras - Create a 3D map. TOF Sensors - Detect Obstacles.
